schema_on_completion.primary_train_oof: 45-cell OOF panel: per-seed medians over fold seeds of equal-family gains; contrasts {RERANK4_minus_r882, RERANK8_minus_r882, RERANK8_minus_RERANK4, RERANK8_minus_RERANK8_SHUF, RERANK8_SHUF_minus_r882} with ci95, ci_holm_m2, p, W/T/L, harm families; Elo (r882 = 1500)
schema_on_completion.secondary_dlval: same on DL-Val91 (fold seed 270140 cells, per-seed 5-cell mixtures)
schema_on_completion.decision: Holm m=2 over PRIMARY and SECONDARY; gates: primary median > +0.002, Holm LCB > 0, 3/3, beats RERANK8_SHUF, secondary 3/3, RERANK8 DL-Train -2.0 picks <= CONTROL
schema_on_completion.invalid_picks: -2.0 picks per arm, DL-Train ASSESS (45 cells) and DL-Val91 (15 cells)
schema_on_completion.oracles: r882, ORACLE_TOP4, ORACLE_TOP8, ORACLE_POOL context and family means (DL-Train, DL-Val91)
schema_on_completion.full_metrics: sha256 + S3 key of the full metrics.json
